beats.en: A rectangular park is 70 m long and 45 m wide. How much will it cost to fence it with 3 rounds of wire at ₹12 per metre? (Enter rupees) → Perimeter (1 round) = 2 × (70 + 45) = 2 × 115 = 230 m. Total wire for 3 rounds = 3 × 230 m = 690 m. Total cost = 690 × ₹12 = ₹8,280.
beats.speakEn: A rectangular park is 70 metres long and 45 metres wide. How much will it cost to fence it with 3 rounds of wire at 12 rupees per metre? (Enter rupees). Perimeter (1 round)  equals  2  times  (70 + 45)  equals  2  times  115  equals  230 metres. Total wire for 3 rounds  equals  3  times  230 metres  equals  690 metres. Total cost  equals  690  times  12 rupees  equals  8 rupees,280.
